provenance: AI-assisted preparation; user review and supervision, not expert gold
coverage_rule: An explicit opposite or wrong numerical answer can be covered. Real omission is partial/missing. Do not repair the answer using reviewer rationale. No coverage policy change.
support_rule: Actual assertions only. Keep raw support, fidelity/object judgments, effective disposition, contract errors and execution placeholders separate. Absence is not contradiction. Valid IDs are not semantic proof.

R1: applies the stipulated score to the threshold; no forced verbatim repetition

cases.answer_boundary: 83 reaches or exceeds 80; omission and retention both permitted. No real-world product conclusion.
cases.review_boundary: Premise restatement, if actually asserted, is task-input fidelity; rule/application, if asserted, need body and applicable premise. Wrong or missing qualifiers must not be repaired in reviewer notes.

R1: responds to given score, even when explicitly misstated
R3: explicit conclusion about this task, even if the calculation/premise is wrong

cases.answer_boundary: Actual given value is 74, below 80; rule expressly disallows omission below threshold. Main-line generation is not forced to make an error.
cases.review_boundary: If generation is correct, record no wrong-premise event observed. Diagnostic answer deliberately says 88: inspect comparison with actual task rather than believing the answer's number.

R1: identifies the given input without inventing a rule
R2: explicit verdict about insufficient delivered support

cases.answer_boundary: Can confirm a stipulated score of 91. Cannot establish the omission permission; cannot import BTV-S1 or its threshold. Honest bounded inability is covered, not blanket refusal.
cases.review_boundary: A positive permission claim has insufficient evidence, not automatic contradiction. Correct statement that the complete delivered input lacks a rule may use actual QA snapshot coverage; do not require fabricated body text or worldwide search.

cases.answer_boundary: The hypothetical value and general description establish neither actual measurement nor safety. Missing records do not prove the real value is different or the device unsafe.
cases.review_boundary: If an actual measurement/safety assertion is added, assess it separately; premise reference/general literature cannot establish it. A correct evidence-limit answer must not automatically become a full on-site engineering assessment. No forced tests or detailed inspection plan.

keep this clause separate if a mixed assertion is split

diagnostic_coverage: All three requirements are explicitly addressed, although premise and application are wrong; no mechanical coverage penalty for an explicit wrong number or conclusion.

reporting.no_reference_unit_count_frozen: Generation is unknown. Clause references here do not force model atomization or count as independent predictions.
reporting.errors_not_triggered: Report not observed/not tested for generated-error detection; do not manufacture an error or count the review as a detection success.
reporting.alignment: Use literal task/answer identity and declared semantic matching. Mixed-label splits or unresolved mapping are listed, not cherry-picked or automatically counted wrong.
reporting.execution: First/final validity, failed, incomplete, unexecuted, partial peers and storage status separately. Contract failure is not semantic insufficiency.
reporting.accounting: invocation_scoped_v1 is an engineering condition; expose correction ownership and initial/final judgments. A format-corrected completion is not itself semantic improvement.
reporting.conclusions: Limited live-model development verification only; not an independent holdout, comparative accuracy gain, production admission or safety proof. No new success-rate threshold.
